rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a female deity, although context can also give it the modern sense of an idealized woman.

example.english: In Greek mythology, Athena is a goddess of wisdom.
example.traditional: 希臘神話入面，雅典娜係智慧女神。
